post.title: Sandbox Space Smoke Test
post.hook: A fixture with no user data, built only to prove a sandbox can launch in one click.
post.summary: A tiny generated workspace of two markdown files used to verify one-click sandbox launch, the sandbox-local Space URL, and follow-up Agents API turns.
post.writeup:
## What it is
A smoke-test fixture: two markdown files, 346 bytes in total, with no code and no user data.

## Why it exists
It gives the sandbox pipeline something safe to run against. The README says it verifies three things: one-click sandbox launch, the sandbox-local Space URL, and follow-up Agents API turns.

## How it works
The fixture is generated and copied into a sandbox. The AGENTS.md file sets the rules: the sandbox agent may inspect and modify only this copied workspace during verification, and the content is intentionally non-sensitive.

## Results
There are no measurements or logs in the folder, and it is not a git repo, so there is no history. The folder only defines what gets checked.

## Open questions
Pass or fail results for each check live elsewhere. Whether the fixture grows beyond two files is unknown.
